name: Static ShortConv · MLP output
tagline: Static local mixing on K/V and attention/MLP branch outputs, without AttnRes.
description: Full-attention Dense with four identity-initialized causal depthwise convolutions per layer. K/V convolutions follow their projections; output convolutions follow the attention and MLP down projections. Retains ordinary residuals, RoPE, QK normalization, value embeddings, squared ReLU and the shared optimizer.
mechanism: Kernel-four static per-channel filters: S(x) = x + DWConv(x), with zero-initialized taps
K before RoPE/QK norm; V before value embeddings; branch convolutions after output projections
No AttnRes, dynamic filters, extra activation or added attention gate
limitations: Fixed-budget placement adaptation, not a reproduction of the complete Inkling or Marin recipe. Packed rows reset convolution state; BOS within a row does not. Full-sequence training/evaluation only; incremental KV-cache decoding is unsupported. Single formal run at seed 42.
